Release notes/v0.7.0/Oct 19, 2026

What's new in Cadence 0.7.0.

Run open models on your Mac as agents. Cadence sets up Ollama, downloads the model and starts it in Claude Code's terminal, with the Inbox, toolbar and Talk working as they do for every agent.

By Cadence Labs · Filed in Releases

§01 New

  • Local models. + › Local model lists the models on your Mac and popular ones to download (Qwen 3.5, Gemma 4, gpt-oss and more), with each one's size and whether it runs well on your Mac's memory. Pick one and Start: it opens in Claude Code's terminal, on that model instead of the cloud.
  • Ollama, set up for you. If Ollama isn't installed, one click downloads Ollama's signed build into ~/.local (no password) and runs it on your Mac only, with the 64K context coding agents need. An Ollama app you already run works as it is.
  • The whole Cadence experience. Local agents get a dot on the toolbar, their questions in the Inbox, titles, your rules, and Talk ("start gemma locally on my project…").
  • Settings › Agents › Local models shows Ollama's status and lets you download and remove models.

Local models are free and private, and less capable than Claude: start them on smaller tasks.

Free for Apple Silicon Macs on macOS 13 or later. The download is always the newest version.
